'''Paradise Road''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], branching off from [[Spacers Row/Legends|Spacers Row]]. [[Masse Goskey/Legends|Masse Goskey's]] famous [[Arms Emporium/Legends|Arms Emporium]] was one of several buildings on this road.<ref name="ItWoSWT" />
